story.what_it_does: Zydus Lifesciences is a drugmaker selling generic and branded medicines in the US, India and international markets. It also has consumer wellness products, medical devices and vaccines. FY2025-26 revenue was about ₹271.5 billion, up 17%.
story.plans: Management guides to high-teens revenue growth and an EBITDA margin of about 24% for FY27. It is building new areas such as a biologics CDMO business, the Saroglitazar launch (US launch planned for FY28) and branded 505(b)(2) products.
story.moat: Zydus has a wide product base, with 508 ANDA filings in total and a chronic-medicine share of 46.3% of its India business. The notes do not describe other competitive advantages in detail. Heavy dependence on a few US products and regulatory inspections are risks to that strength.

scenarios.story: New launches, Indian growth ahead of the market and branded US products lift revenue above guidance. Margins recover toward the 28-30% medium-term goal.
signals_to_watch: Branded share of US business rising from the 16% reported in Q2 FY27
EBITDA margin moving back up from 24.0% in Q2 FY27

scenarios.story: Revenue grows at a high-teens pace with margins near 24% as Saroglitazar launch spending ramps up. US sales grow only in single digits as Revlimid fades and Mirabegron competition arrives.
signals_to_watch: US growth staying near single digits as guided
Net debt to EBITDA staying below the 1 times comfort level (0.62 times at 30 Sep 2026)

scenarios.story: Margins stay well below last year's levels and profit keeps falling while debt rises. Further USFDA observations or legal cases add costs and delay launches.
signals_to_watch: Outcome of USFDA observations at the SEZ II and Moraiya sites
Net debt rising further from ₹51,998 mn at 30 Sep 2026
